spell_mastery_ability.adaptive_casting.name: Adaptive Casting
spell_mastery_ability.adaptive_casting.description: Use this spell's mastery score and all its special abilities whenever you cast a similar spell. If several mastery Abilities apply to one casting, you may use only one Ability's score and the special abilities taken for it.

spell_mastery_ability.ceremonial_casting.name: Ceremonial Casting
spell_mastery_ability.ceremonial_casting.description: Apply the rules for Ceremonial Casting to this spell. May not be taken for Ritual spells, which already use ceremonial casting.

spell_mastery_ability.fast_casting.name: Fast Casting
spell_mastery_ability.fast_casting.description: Fast Cast the mastered spell per the rules for fast-casting spontaneous spells (still taking the -10 penalty and extra botch dice). May not be taken for Ritual spells.

spell_mastery_ability.imperturbable_cast.name: Imperturbable Casting
spell_mastery_ability.imperturbable_cast.description: Add the caster's Mastery score to all Concentration rolls related to the spell, helping maintain Concentration-Duration spells amid distraction.

spell_mastery_ability.magic_resistance.name: Magic Resistance
spell_mastery_ability.magic_resistance.description: Your Magic Resistance is doubled against the mastered spell and against any spells or powers that count as similar.

spell_mastery_ability.multiple_casting.name: Multiple Casting
spell_mastery_ability.multiple_casting.description: Cast several copies of the spell at once, up to your Mastery Score in additional copies, each rolled separately. A -1 aiming penalty applies per target. May be taken for Ritual spells (one pawn of vis per magnitude per copy).

spell_mastery_ability.obfuscated_casting.name: Obfuscated Casting
spell_mastery_ability.obfuscated_casting.description: Magi cannot automatically identify the Form of the spell as you cast it; they must roll and add the caster's Mastery score to the Ease Factor.

spell_mastery_ability.penetration.name: Penetration
spell_mastery_ability.penetration.description: The caster's Mastery Score is added to her Penetration Ability score for determining her Penetration Bonus.

spell_mastery_ability.precise_casting.name: Precise Casting
spell_mastery_ability.precise_casting.description: Add +1 to all Finesse rolls with the spell (including aiming) and subtract one botch die from those rolls, to a minimum of one. May be taken multiple times for the same spell.

spell_mastery_ability.quick_casting.name: Quick Casting
spell_mastery_ability.quick_casting.description: Add +1 to the caster's Initiative Total when casting the mastered spell (and +1 to Fast Casting Speed rolls if also Fast Casting). May not be taken for Ritual spells. May be taken multiple times for the same spell.

spell_mastery_ability.quiet_casting.name: Quiet Casting
spell_mastery_ability.quiet_casting.description: The penalty for casting the spell quietly is reduced by five (never a bonus). May be taken twice, allowing the spell to be cast silently without penalty.

spell_mastery_ability.rebuttal.name: Rebuttal
spell_mastery_ability.rebuttal.description: For a Muto or Rego Vim spell designed to affect another being's spell or power, add three times your Mastery score to the Vim spell's effective level when determining whether it can change or control the foreign magic.

spell_mastery_ability.still_casting.name: Still Casting
spell_mastery_ability.still_casting.description: Cast the spell without gestures at no penalty. The normal bonus for exaggerated gestures still applies.

spell_mastery_ability.unravelling.name: Unravelling
spell_mastery_ability.unravelling.description: For a Perdo Vim spell designed to weaken or destroy magic, add three times your Mastery score to the Perdo Vim spell's effective level when determining whether it can destroy the targeted effect.
